title: WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR
subtitle: WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR CHAIN. OPEN THE HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT BRIDGES, ROWS, AND LUNGES. FLEXIBILITY WOVEN IN. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. WEDNESDAY. POSTERIOR. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LIGHT BRIDGES, ROWS, AND LUNGES. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. WEDNESDAY POSTERIOR DONE. HIPS OPEN. HAMSTRINGS HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: FIGURE-4 HIP OPENER
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. ANKLE ON THE OPPOSITE KNEE. GENTLY PULL THE BOTTOM THIGH TOWARD YOU. HIP OPENER. BREATHE. DO NOT YANK.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR HIP OPENERS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE ON THE KNEE. GENTLE PULL. THIS IS YOUR HIP OPENER. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A BLOODY LAWNMOWER.

exercises.name: STANDING HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON A LOW STAIR OR THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE. HINGE AT THE HIPS. REACH TOWARD THE SHIN. HAMSTRING STRETCH. LONG SPINE. NO BOUNCING.
exercises.speakStart: STANDING HAMSTRING STRETCHES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL UP. HINGE AT THE HIPS. LONG SPINE. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY KANGAROO.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET PLANTED. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. POSTERIOR WORK. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THE HIPS UP. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR POSTERIOR. DO NOT ARCH YOUR BACK LIKE A BLOODY BANANA.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. HIPS LOOSE. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. POSTERIOR PULL AFTER THE DESK. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. POSTERIOR PULL. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. HIP HINGE PATTERN. LIGHT STRENGTH. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. LIGHT POSTERIOR WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. FIND YOUR FEET. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG STAND
exercises.cue: STAND TALL. ONE FOOT OFF THE FLOOR. SOFT KNEE ON THE STANDING LEG. LIGHT FINGERTIPS ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. EYES FORWARD. OWN IT.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG STANDS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH LEG. ONE FOOT UP. SOFT KNEE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A BLOODY DRUNK AT CLOSING TIME.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SWITCH LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. STACK THE SHOULDERS. DO NOT SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. LIFT THE HIPS. HOLD. LIGHT FINISH. DO NOT SAG LIKE A BLOODY HAMMOCK.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
